Author: OpenCodexMicro
Name: Codex CLI
Overview: Monitor and control Codex CLI tasks, approvals, and turns from Ulanzi D200 Series in Ulanzi Studio.
Description:
Turn Ulanzi D200 Series into a dedicated Codex CLI control surface through Ulanzi Studio.

FEATURES
- View recent Codex CLI sessions with live status and elapsed execution timer.
- One-touch Approve and Cancel / Reject actions for tool execution and diffs.
- Attention alert badge jumping directly to approval requests.
- Token consumption tracker and session status HUD.
- Quick prompt queuing and resume session triggers.
- Keep communication local through loopback-only endpoints.
